$comment: Strings the Hebrew UI draws at random instead of showing one fixed sentence.

Key = '<namespace>/<dictionary key>' — the namespace must exist in dicts/index.json and the key must exist in its English source under dicts/en/. Value = the pool the browser half picks from; the picked value REPLACES the Hebrew dictionary value for that key.

build-client.mjs validates every entry (known namespace, known key, at least two non-empty values, no {placeholder}) and refuses the build otherwise, then bakes the pools into lib/client.js. A pool whose English source ends with '...' gets the Hebrew ellipsis '…' appended to whatever it picks.
conversation/hero.headline — the blank-session hero title (was the single string 'אל הלא־נודע').
chat/chat.deepDiving — the turn-status word shown beside the composer while the agent works (English 'Deep diving...').
